paragraphs: Multiple biscuit and sandwich products are being recalled this week due to Listeria contamination risks [1][3][5]. Fresh & Ready Foods LLC expanded its recall to include Meals Made in Minutes Brand Biscuit & Sausage Gravy and additional Fresh To You Brand Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches produced at its Longview, Texas facility [5]. Grand Strand Sandwich Company is recalling Lunch Box brand biscuit sandwiches, including Chicken Sausage, Sausage Egg and Cheese, Jumbo Sausage, and Bacon Egg and Cheese varieties, distributed between March 2 and November 10 [3][10]. If you purchased these products, do not eat them and discard or return them to the store [1][3][5].

An E. coli outbreak at Ohio University has grown to 17 confirmed cases among students [14]. Separately, an outbreak of E. coli infections is under investigation at Tufts University with five confirmed cases as of November 19, with Fresh at Carmichael Dining Center as the suspected source [8].

The FDA has issued additional recalls for allergen concerns [2][7]. Shanghai San Niu Food Co. is recalling Sanniu Evergreen Biscuits and Salt and Pepper Soda Biscuits due to undeclared milk and milk with shrimp [2]. Naia Inc. is recalling Chocolate Banana Bar Sorbetto with specific code dates because it may contain undeclared tree nuts, milk, and eggs [7].

An outbreak of cryptosporidiosis linked to raw milk from Wethington Farms near Amarillo, Texas is under investigation, with three of six confirmed patients reporting consumption of raw milk from that source [18].
